newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Canada says considering sanctions on Burma.
newsitem.headline: Canada says considering sanctions on Burma.

text.p: Canadian Foreign Minister Lloyd Axworthy will recommend that the Canadian government impose new economic measures against Burma, a spokesman for the Canadian delegation at Asian security talks said on Tuesday.
Axworthy was in Kuala Lumpur to attend the annual meeting of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) together with other Asian and Western powers.
The delegation spokesman said the sanctions "would be in the area of trade and investment."
Canada has already banned development aid and export guarantees for Burma.
"Now we are going to consider further economic measures," the spokesman said.
He said Axworthy would go back to Ottawa to discuss the proposal with his cabinet colleagues.
Burma joined ASEAN last week, much to the dismay of Western governments who wanted to see Rangoon put beyond the pale over its record on human rights and democracy.
Western representatives at the ASEAN meetings expressed strong disappointment with Burmese Foreign Minister Ohn Gyaw over Burma's progress report on political reforms.
